mapper.select:
select max(cxr.SCHEDULE_DATE) SCHEDULE_DATE, /*排程日期*/ max(cxr.CX_BATCH_NO) CX_BATCH_NO, /*成型批次号*/ ci.INSIDE_CODE LINING_CODE, /*内衬代码*/ max(substr(ci.INSIDE_RUBBER,1, INSTR(ci.INSIDE_RUBBER||'/','/')-1)) GLUE_CODE, /*胶料,施工信息表取的胶料代码是'/'分割的，默认只需要取第一个胶料*/ max(ci.INSIDE_RUBBER) WHOLE_GLUE_CODE, /*胶料代码(完整没有截取的)*/ nvl(max(ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH),0) UNIT_CONSUME, /*单耗(内衬单耗是使用胎侧长度)*/ nvl(ceil(sum(cxr.CLASS1_PLAN_QTY*ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH/1000)),0) CX_CLASS1_PLAN, /*对应成型一班的内衬胶计划量=成型计划量*单耗/1000 */ nvl(ceil(sum(cxr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY*ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH/1000)),0) CX_CLASS2_PLAN, /*对应成型二班的内衬胶计划量*/ nvl(ceil(sum(cxr.CLASS3_PLAN_QTY*ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH/1000)),0) CX_CLASS3_PLAN, /*对应成型二班的内衬胶计划量*/ nvl(ceil(sum(cxr.CLASS4_PLAN_QTY*ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH/1000)),0) CX_CLASS4_PLAN, /*对应成型次日一班的内衬胶计划量*/ nvl(ceil(sum(cxr.CLASS5_PLAN_QTY*ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH/1000)),0) CX_CLASS5_PLAN, /*对应成型次日二班的内衬胶计划量*/ regexp_replace(listagg(cxr.CX_MACHINE_CODE||'$'||cxr.EMBRYO_CODE||'$'||cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION,',') within group (order by cxr.CX_MACHINE_CODE,cxr.EMBRYO_CODE,cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION), '([^,]+)(,\1)+', '\1') as quotaKeys /*机台code$胎胚代码*/ from T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION /*施工信息表*/ where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
and cxr.DEL_FLAG = 0 and ci.DEL_FLAG = 0 group by ci.INSIDE_CODE
mapper.insert: insert into T_NC_SCHEDULE_RESULT_LOG (ID, SCHEDULE_DATE, CX_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, LINING_CODE, GLUE_CODE, WHOLE_GLUE_CODE, GLUE_SEQ, MOUTH_PLATE_CODE, UNIT_CONSUME, MACHINE_ID, STOCK_QTY, SUPPLY_TIME, DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_FINISH_QTY, DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER, DAY_FINISH_RATE, DAY_SYS_ANALYSIS, DAY_HAND_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER, NIGHT_FINISH_RATE, NIGHT_SYS_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_HAND_ANALYSIS, PRE_PLAN_QTY, CX_CLASS1_PLAN, CX_CLASS2_PLAN, CX_CLASS3_PLAN, CX_CLASS4_PLAN, CX_CLASS5_PLAN, IS_RELEASE,MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP,PRODUCTION_STATUS, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME,data_source,PUBLISH_SUCCESS_COUNT, NEWEST_PUBLISH_TIME,CLOSE_OUT_SPEC_FLAG) select ID, SCHEDULE_DATE, CX_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, LINING_CODE, GLUE_CODE, WHOLE_GLUE_CODE, GLUE_SEQ, MOUTH_PLATE_CODE, UNIT_CONSUME, MACHINE_ID, STOCK_QTY, SUPPLY_TIME, DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_FINISH_QTY, DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER, DAY_FINISH_RATE, DAY_SYS_ANALYSIS, DAY_HAND_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER, NIGHT_FINISH_RATE, NIGHT_SYS_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_HAND_ANALYSIS, PRE_PLAN_QTY, CX_CLASS1_PLAN, CX_CLASS2_PLAN, CX_CLASS3_PLAN, CX_CLASS4_PLAN, CX_CLASS5_PLAN, IS_RELEASE,MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP,PRODUCTION_STATUS, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME,data_source,PUBLISH_SUCCESS_COUNT, NEWEST_PUBLISH_TIME,CLOSE_OUT_SPEC_FLAG from T_NC_SCHEDULE_RESULT where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
mapper.delete: delete from T_NC_SCHEDULE_RESULT where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
mapper.update: update T_NC_ASSIST_SCHEDULE set DEL_FLAG = '1', UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
mapper.insert: insert into T_NC_AUTO_SCHEDULE_RECORD (ID, CX_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, STATUS, SCHEDULE_DATE, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, DEL_FLAG) values (SEQ_AUTO_SCHEDULE_RECORD.Nextval, #{cxBatchNo}, #{batchNo}, '0', to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd'), #{userName}, sysdate, '0')
mapper.select: select param_code, param_value from T_NC_PARAMS where DEL_FLAG = '0'
SELECT MAX(BATCH_NO) BATCH_NO FROM t_nc_auto_schedule_record where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')

select c.INSIDE_CODE liningCode, max(substr(c.INSIDE_RUBBER,1, INSTR(c.INSIDE_RUBBER||'/','/')-1)) GLUE_CODE, max(c.INSIDE_RUBBER) WHOLE_GLUE_CODE, /*胶料代码(完整没有截取的)*/ nvl(max(c.SIDEWALL_LENGTH),0) UNIT_CONSUME from T_CONSTRUCTION_VERSION_INFO c where c.Del_Flag = '0'
and PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
and c.INSIDE_CODE in #{liningCode} group by c.INSIDE_CODE

select cxr.EMBRYO_CODE || ',' ||ci.EMBRYO_CODE EMBRYO_CODE, /*成型排程胎胚代码，施工表的胎胚代码*/ cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION || ',' || ci.EMBRYO_VERSION as BOM_DATA_VERSION, /*成型排程胎胚版本，施工表的胎胚版本*/ ci.INSIDE_CODE, /*内衬代码*/ ci.INSIDE_RUBBER, /*内衬胶料代码*/ ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH /*内衬长*/ from ( select EMBRYO_CODE,BOM_DATA_VERSION from T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT where DEL_FLAG = 0 and schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') group by EMBRYO_CODE, BOM_DATA_VERSION ) cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ left join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION and ci.DEL_FLAG = 0 where 1=1
and (ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0' or ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE is null)

select ID, SCHEDULE_DATE, CX_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, LINING_CODE, GLUE_CODE, WHOLE_GLUE_CODE, GLUE_SEQ, MOUTH_PLATE_CODE, UNIT_CONSUME, MACHINE_ID, STOCK_QTY, SUPPLY_TIME, nvl(DAY_PLAN_QTY,0) DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_FINISH_QTY, DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER, DAY_FINISH_RATE, DAY_SYS_ANALYSIS, DAY_HAND_ANALYSIS, nvl(NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, 0) NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER, NIGHT_FINISH_RATE, NIGHT_SYS_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_HAND_ANALYSIS, PRE_PLAN_QTY, CX_CLASS1_PLAN, CX_CLASS2_PLAN, CX_CLASS3_PLAN, CX_CLASS4_PLAN, CX_CLASS5_PLAN, IS_RELEASE, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP, PRODUCTION_STATUS, DATA_SOURCE, PUBLISH_SUCCESS_COUNT, NEWEST_PUBLISH_TIME from t_nc_schedule_result r where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') and DEL_FLAG = 0
select MATERIAL_CODE from T_NC_ASSIST_SPEC where DEL_FLAG='0'

SELECT ci.INSIDE_CODE FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT R INNER JOIN T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI ON R.EMBRYO_CODE = CI.EMBRYO_CODE AND R.BOM_DATA_VERSION = CI.EMBRYO_VERSION INNER JOIN T_NC_PARAMS P ON P.PARAM_CODE = 'CLOSE_OUT_SPEC_REMARK' AND P.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND P.PARAM_VALUE IS NOT NULL WHERE R.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate} AND R.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND CI.DEL_FLAG = '0'
/* 仅对投产阶段的规格排产 */ AND CI.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
AND (REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R.CLASS1_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) OR REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R.CLASS1_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) OR REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R.CLASS2_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) OR REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R.CLASS2_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) OR REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R.CLASS3_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) OR REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R.CLASS3_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) OR REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R.CLASS4_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) OR REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R.CLASS4_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) OR REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R.CLASS5_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) OR REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R.CLASS5_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE))
AND NOT EXISTS /*同一个施工只看几天内最后一天的排产是否收尾*/ (SELECT 1 FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT R2 LEFT JOIN T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI2 ON R2.EMBRYO_CODE = CI2.EMBRYO_CODE AND R2.BOM_DATA_VERSION = CI2.EMBRYO_VERSION WHERE R2.SCHEDULE_DATE BETWEEN R.SCHEDULE_DATE - #{closeOutDays} AND R.SCHEDULE_DATE AND CI2.INSIDE_CODE = CI.INSIDE_CODE AND r.id != r2.id AND R2.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND CI2.DEL_FLAG = '0'
/* 仅对投产阶段的规格排产 */ AND CI2.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT R3 WHERE R3.SCHEDULE_DATE BETWEEN R.SCHEDULE_DATE - #{closeOutDays} AND R.SCHEDULE_DATE AND R3.EMBRYO_CODE = R2.EMBRYO_CODE AND R3.BOM_DATA_VERSION = R2.BOM_DATA_VERSION AND R3.SCHEDULE_DATE > R2.SCHEDULE_DATE AND R3.DEL_FLAG = '0' )
AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R2.CLASS1_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R2.CLASS1_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R2.CLASS2_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R2.CLASS2_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R2.CLASS3_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R2.CLASS3_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R2.CLASS4_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R2.CLASS4_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R2.CLASS5_ANALYSIS, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE) AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(R2.CLASS5_ANALYSIS_INPUT, ' '), P.PARAM_VALUE)) GROUP BY CI.INSIDE_CODE
